from math import *
def appro():
    nb=1
    x0=1
    x1=log(x0)+2
    d=abs(x0-x1)
    while d >= (10**-5):
        x0=x1
        x1=log(x0)+2
        d=abs(x0-x1)
        nb=nb+1
    print("La valeur approché est: ",x1)
    print("Le nombre d'iteration est: ",nb)
appro()
